candidate.title: FRT-Seq
candidate.scope: The middle FRT-Seq row of the supplied Illumina poster: preparation of poly(A)+ RNA with sequential 3′ P7 and 5′ P5 chimeric adapters, gel purification/5′ phosphorylation, and on-flowcell hybridization and reverse transcription. FRT-Seq means flowcell reverse transcription sequencing; this is a single schematic implementation, without a separately declared version or alternative branch. The PAL-seq row above, ChIRP row below, clipped material above them and right-side chemical legend are surrounding context and are not connected to this workflow. The final single line is interpreted as the DNA copy at the flowcell interface, not as a depicted sequencing run. This is an assay architecture, not a complete protocol.

operations.label: Fragment and dephosporylate
operations.description: Convert the starting poly(A)+ RNA into shorter RNA fragments and remove terminal phosphate groups; the product is shown with 5′ OH and 3′ OH ends. The source spelling of the caption is retained.
operations.information_effect: Changes the physical unit from an intact RNA to an RNA segment. The library can represent sequence within the starting poly(A)+ population; it does not retain intact-transcript length in each insert.

operations.label: P7 primer
operations.description: Join the phosphate-bearing 5′ end of the P7 RNA–DNA adapter to the RNA fragment 3′ OH. The output is RNA with a 3′ P7 adapter, an unchanged insert 5′ OH, and the adapter’s terminal ddC block.
operations.mechanism: 3′ adapter ligation, identified explicitly in the secondary FRT-Seq catalogue paragraph; no specific ligase is asserted.
operations.information_effect: Installs the P7 flowcell interface at a defined end of the RNA insert, while the insert remains RNA.

operations.label: Hybridize to flowcell and reverse-transcribe
operations.description: Hybridize the dual-adapter RNA library to the flowcell and reverse-transcribe the captured RNA there, producing a flowcell-associated DNA copy. The figure combines capture and copying into one block and renders its endpoint only as a line.
operations.mechanism: On-flowcell reverse transcription using unamplified, adapter-ligated mRNA as template, supported directly by the paper abstract. Detailed surface-primer geometry is not depicted.
operations.information_effect: Transfers the RNA insert sequence and its orientation into the cDNA carrier for downstream sequencing. The paper abstract reports strand-specific paired-end data; the schematic does not depict cluster generation or the sequencing cycles. The represented biological population is the starting poly(A)+ RNA, not the whole RNA population. Fragment reads do not alone establish full-length transcript structure or poly(A)-tail length.
